name: rf_phy_chan_edge_apply

params.purpose: Destination word whose top bit is cleared before being stored
Value masked (top bit cleared) and written through the destination pointer
Channel center frequency in MHz used to select band-edge PHY register presets

docstring: Applies PHY/MDM register presets for 2.4GHz band-edge channels based on center frequency and clears the top bit of a stored calibration word.
